workspace-safety-gate.description: Antigravity Workspace Safety Gate: Protects raw data immutability, blocks catastrophic commands, clean root, and enforces ASCII filenames.

hooks.command: python3 -c "import os,sys; f='.agents/hooks/workspace_safety_dispatcher.py' if os.path.exists('.agents/hooks/workspace_safety_dispatcher.py') else 'hooks/workspace_safety_dispatcher.py'; os.execv(sys.executable, [sys.executable, f] + sys.argv[1:])" --event PreToolUse
